title: Colombian coffee cooperative, two dry seasons (English), contrast partner of S1
profile_note: Synthetic producer (#7): coffee cooperative, Cauca, Colombia, with weather station and cover crop projects. Same challenge, crop and region as S1; only the entity type differs (cooperative vs smallholder). The SYN-008 run for contrast pair C4, which is judged on the reviewer mark alone because the two share regional facts.

turns.message: It hasn't rained like it used to. Our members have had two seasons of very irregular rain and last year's coffee harvest dropped a lot across the cooperative.
It started at the end of 2024. Members lost about a third of the crop. We put weather stations on member farms and planted cover crops, but it wasn't enough.

intake_replies: Some members also saved water in tanks, but the rain just did not come.
